children: SOBR Safe clarified it is exploring options and has postponed its 2026 Annual General Meeting; the Board has not decided to dissolve the company.
Posted press release clarifying third-party reports and stating no Board or stockholder decision to dissolve.
Board previously set the 2026 Annual Meeting for Nov. 2, 2026, but has now postponed it to a later date.
Company will provide updated meeting details and any revised record date in a future communication.
